content.text: The failure boundary is now clear: Python 3.10’s `get_type_hints()` reprocesses the already-evaluated `Annotated` objects that the command inventory installs at runtime; source annotations do not take that path. I’m changing the compiler contract so only deferred string annotations come from `get_type_hints()`, while concrete runtime annotations remain authoritative. This removes dependence on private `typing` internals and covers every generated command, not just `average.weight`.
